changes.comment: BREAKING: OpenAiThinkingModelNames drops o3-deep-research and o4-mini-deep-research (shut down by OpenAI on 2026-07-23), so code naming them in a thinking models filter no longer compiles. ai-assist: rotate the model catalog. OpenAI tiers move to the GPT-6 line (@openai:mini gpt-6-luna, @openai:flagship gpt-6-sol, @openai:pro gpt-6-astra) and @openai:image to gpt-image-2.5-sunburst; Gemini @google-gemini:flash to gemini-3.8-flash and @google-gemini:flash-lite to gemini-3.5-flash-lite; xAI @xai-grok:flagship to grok-4.7 and @xai-grok:imagine to grok-imagine-image-2.0 (grok-imagine-image-quality retires 2026-11-02). New listModels idPattern rules classify gpt-6, grok-4.7 and grok-4.6 ids as thinking-capable. grok-imagine-image-2.0 declares the quality param (low | medium | auto) and both xAI image builders now send it when the model's capability declares it. The thinking and image *ModelNames unions gain the new ids; o3-deep-research and o4-mini-deep-research (shut down 2026-07-23) are removed from OpenAiThinkingModelNames. Thinking: descriptors declare thinkingRequiredModelPrefixes (gpt-6-astra, grok-4.5, grok-4.6, grok-4.7, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-2.5-pro), and a generic effort 'none' on such a model is sent as 'low' unless the new IThinkingConfig.onUnsupported is 'fail', which refuses the call before the wire. isThinkingRequiredModel is exported. Anthropic aliases are unchanged: claude-opus-5-5 and claude-fable-5-1 reject the forced tool_choice that Anthropic structured output depends on.
